name: @hegel/hfq
description: The hegel federated query interpreter (HFQ), vendored for Buhera OS. A plan language with a capability calculus and a six-verdict execution model (answer/empty/surface/timeout/refused/starved), running the full parse -> resolve -> check -> allocate -> execute -> emit pipeline locally, with no network I/O. Includes the biocatalysis fixture with Mark Doerr's five real questions (mark_q1-mark_q5) and the eight generic Chem-DCAT-AP queries (dcat_g1-dcat_g8). Public surface: runPlan(source), selectWorld(plan), WORLDS, plus the full model/parser/adapters/check/allocate/execute exports.
author: Kundai Farai Sachikonye <kundai.sachikonye@wzw.tum.de>
